title: Bib Collection Readiness Monthly Throughput Trend
dataSources: Race results (`raceresult:event`), TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), marathon splits (`race:split`), bib pickup and race logistics (`race:bib`).
app: Race result APIs, TrainingPeaks workouts and TSS, marathon split exports, and bib-collection checklists streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted REST inputs, CSV imports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=race:bib
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as items sum(eval(if(pickup_status="collected",1,0))) as completed by _time
| sort - _time
description: Tracks how many bib pickups entered the system each month and how many actually got completed.
value: Throughput trend lines show whether the queue is shrinking, flat, or quietly becoming a backlog.
implementation: Use this after any process cleanup to see whether the change actually improved completion volume.
visualization: Column chart of monthly created versus completed bib pickups.
grandmaExplanation: It turns whether you are clearing bib pickups as fast as they arrive each month.
